We consider nDTW as the main metric of the new NDH-FULL task because nDTW reflects path fidelity better than other metrics. Other than nDTW, we also present evaluation results on success rate (SR), success weighted by path length (SPL), trajectory length (TL), and goal progress (GP) to allow evaluation from different perspectives.
